description: JSON command results are versioned and every documented command and flag is checked against the real CLI
rationale: Telos reviews found README and integration examples drifting from CLI flags and JSON wrappers, which breaks agent integrations that trust the docs. Agents here own the interaction, so the contract must be explicit and tested.
requirements: Every JSON command result carries output_version and only gains fields within a version; canonical records keep schema_version
Every subcommand and flag in documented intentctl invocations exists in the CLI
Every CLI subcommand is documented in README.md or AGENTS.md
title: Versioned command output and docs-as-tests
